# Rashi Sharma — AI & Web Developer Portfolio

> Rashi Sharma is a web developer and digital marketing specialist from Pundri, Kaithal, Haryana, India. She builds responsive websites, browser games and AI-assisted marketing work. NIELIT O Level qualified (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, IoT, C++), currently pursuing Digital Marketing with AI.

Rashi Sharma combines web development with digital marketing and AI tooling. She is available for website development, SEO and digital marketing projects.

## Who is Rashi Sharma?
